name: VISUAL 150 GB staged public-data acquisition plan

storage.recommended_location: user-controlled persistent disk or object storage

candidate_sources.name: Wikimedia dumps
candidate_sources.rights: CC BY-SA/GFDL; attribution and share-alike obligations; verify dump and component terms

candidate_sources.name: Wikidata dumps
candidate_sources.rights: structured data CC0; media and linked resources have separate rights

candidate_sources.name: Project Gutenberg
candidate_sources.rights: item-level public-domain status varies by jurisdiction; verify each title

candidate_sources.name: OpenAlex snapshot
candidate_sources.rights: metadata CC0; linked full text has separate rights

allocation.selection_rule: Prefer incremental or topic/language partitions; do not mirror whole snapshots by default.

candidate_sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice
candidate_sources.rights: verify current release license, language package and speaker-data terms before use

candidate_sources.name: LibriSpeech
candidate_sources.rights: verify current corpus license and source audiobook terms

allocation.selection_rule: Prioritize Hindi and multilingual speech; preserve speaker metadata only as permitted; remove personal/sensitive material.

candidate_sources.name: COCO
candidate_sources.rights: image rights and annotation license differ; verify image-level terms

candidate_sources.name: Open Images
candidate_sources.rights: verify image-level license and attribution metadata

allocation.selection_rule: Download only items with explicit compatible licenses; keep attribution and source identifiers.

candidate_sources.name: NOAA NCEI
candidate_sources.rights: verify product-level terms and third-party content

candidate_sources.name: GBIF
candidate_sources.rights: record-level CC0/CC BY/CC BY-NC; exclude incompatible records

allocation.selection_rule: Prefer well-documented scientific products with stable identifiers, checksums and clear reuse terms.

candidate_sources.name: GitHub public repositories
candidate_sources.rights: repository license must explicitly permit intended use; no-license repositories excluded

candidate_sources.name: Stack Exchange data
candidate_sources.rights: CC BY-SA; attribution and share-alike obligations

allocation.selection_rule: Use only licensed source code and technical Q&A; scan for secrets, personal data, malware and generated/vendor files.

candidate_sources.name: World Bank indicators
candidate_sources.rights: many datasets CC BY 4.0; verify individual dataset

allocation.selection_rule: Prefer machine-readable CSV/JSON/SDMX and retain units, definitions, geography and time coverage.

quality_gates: Record publisher, canonical URL, retrieval timestamp, license URL/text, version and checksum.
Reject unknown, conflicting, non-commercial or share-alike terms unless the downstream use is compatible.
Verify archive structure and expected file count before extraction; block path traversal and archive bombs.
Deduplicate exact hashes and near-duplicates; retain lineage rather than deleting provenance.
Validate schema, encoding, missingness, corruption, language, OCR quality and label consistency.
Separate source-level train/validation/test splits to reduce leakage.
Generate a dataset card and sample-review report for every imported dataset.
Report bytes downloaded, bytes accepted, bytes rejected, records indexed and errors separately.

execution.phase_0: Measure persistent free storage and network budget; no download if storage gate fails.
execution.phase_1: Resolve official manifests and item-level licenses; produce a reviewed acquisition manifest.
execution.phase_2: Download one bounded shard at a time with resume, checksum and per-host rate limits.
execution.phase_3: Stream-parse archives; do not load large corpora fully into RAM.
execution.phase_4: Deduplicate, screen privacy/sensitive data, validate labels and build provenance.
execution.phase_5: Build RAG index and separate training-ready JSONL/Parquet shards.
execution.phase_6: Run held-out evaluation before any fine-tuning; version data and model artifacts.

important_limit: 150 GB is a target budget, not data already collected. This manifest does not authorize or start bulk downloads. Dataset sizes, access URLs and licenses must be re-verified against the publisher before each shard is enabled.
